effective.basis: Old state: UDE official card rulings (Sangan/Witch: 'If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify', captured 2005-06-16) through Konami's own per-set rulings documents - Machina Mayhem (2010-04-06, 18 days before the Edison snapshot), Starstrike Blast (2010-11-16), Storm of Ragnarok (2011-02-02). New state: KDE-US Tournament Policy section 'Card/Hand/Deck Verification' forbids verifying the opponent's Deck (first located capture 2019-04-03; still current in v2.5, 2025-09-05). No dated announcement of the change was found, so the interval 2011-02-02 .. 2019-04-03 stays open.

changes.historical_text: When this card is sent to your Graveyard, you can remove this card from the Graveyard to Special Summon 1 "Peten the Dark Clown" from your hand or Deck.
changes.summary: Period procedure, not a text erratum: after this card is banished as cost, if no other 'Peten the Dark Clown' is in the hand or Deck, the goat script reveals both zones (Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_DECK)); the modern script simply resolves without effect. No lineage version prints reveal wording.

changes.historical_text: When this card is sent to your Graveyard, you can remove this card from the Graveyard to Special Summon 1 "Peten the Dark Clown" from your hand or Deck.
changes.summary: Separate per-card era allowance: the goat target keeps only `Duel.GetLocationCount(tp,LOCATION_MZONE)>0` where the modern target also requires `Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.filter,tp,LOCATION_HAND|LOCATION_DECK,0,1,nil,e,tp)`, so the period implementation lets the Trigger be activated and this card banished from the Graveyard as cost with no second copy to Summon - permanently losing the copy for nothing. The packet dates no end for that allowance.

review.notes: I read both scripts in full: goat/c504700084.lua and official/c52624755.lua both set the cost to Cost.SelfBanish, so the era 'remove this card from the Graveyard' wording (v0, EP1-EN005, 2004-07-25) is already implemented as a banish and its clarification to 'remove from play' (v1, DPKB-EN019, 2010-04-16) and then 'banish' (v2, Silver Dragon Value Box, 2013-09-13) is cosmetic, as is the GY rewording at v3 (OP16-EN017, 2021-06-09). The remaining diff lines - MODID vs id resolving to 52624755, and LOCATION_DECK+LOCATION_HAND vs LOCATION_DECK|LOCATION_HAND - are non-behavioural. Intermediate-state reasoning as for the other GoatConfirm cards: the two ruling transitions are unordered, no upstream implementation covers the state between them, and none is attached because GOAT (2005-04-01) and Edison (2010-04-24) both precede 2011-02-02.
